changelog: Fix: when On Hold was retired in 1.0.12, jobs that were paused mid-production were sent back to the very first stage — a job paused at Post-press reappeared in Design Pending, and a paused delivery job went back to Ready for Print. Paused jobs are now returned to the exact stage they were paused at, read from their own status history, and any job already moved wrongly is put back automatically.

Fix: an order's stage is now re-derived from its actual item stages (the lowest stage wins) instead of being guessed, so the orders list, order page and customer tracking page no longer show a stage the job has already passed.
